title: Node suite red at base: a2l test under-times the discipline guard
body:
harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts fails on epic/43y at the base of this attempt (reproduced at dd29e32c0): every process-driving test must declare timeout >= 300_000 (the fim/hv3 rule), and tick a2l's 'an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore' (harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts:140) declares 120_000. CI's harness job runs `pnpm test`, which is BOTH vitest configs, so the epic branch's CI is red at head and the close-out's CI-green gate cannot pass until it is fixed. Fix is one line: raise that test's timeout to 300_000.
evidence: harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts:141 (timeout: 120_000); harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts:495 — `cd harness && pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts` fails with 'expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []'
